Eight Heads — Innate Technique (11th level)

At 11th level, when you have at least 3 Fangs of Orochi summoned, you can command them as an action for 6 cursed energy to move up to 40 ft, encircle a creature, and embed themselves into the ground in an unoccupied area. A barrier forms, connecting the Fangs like a cylinder resembling a trigram and trapping any within.

The barrier has a height of 20 ft and can have a maximum diameter of 15 ft. It has 20 AC and hit points equal to the hit points of the Fangs of Orochi used to create it. A trapped creature makes a cursed energy save at the start of their turns, taking 10d4 necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much on a successful save.

If this damage reduces a humanoid to 0 hit points, the creature dies and you regain one life. Once you regain a life in this way, you cannot for 1 week.
